Terms & Conditions

By claiming an address, bridging and wrapping TAO, you recognize and take on risk. This risk being usage of the bridge.

Should anything happen to the bridge or the underlying keys securing tokens, you might not be able to redeem back. To mitigate risk, refrain from storing wTAO in large quantities and bridge back to mainnet when possible.
Also note, all bridged tokens are staked in TaoBridge.xyz's validator node and are unstaked at time of withdrawal as needed.
If you acknowledge these terms and wish to bridge at your own risk, please continue.
